dataset: Vegeta S3 translated native CosmWasm workload

measurement_policy.matched_serial: fresh matched serial engine per strategy/sample; same translated blocks and predecessor state
measurement_policy.state_correctness: strategy engine world state must equal matched serial after every block
measurement_policy.static_visibility: checked-in source-derived symbolic profiles plus public translated call inputs only
measurement_policy.adaptive_feedback: strictly prior blocks only; canonical concrete conflicts and transaction service cost become visible after the prior block
measurement_policy.exact_access: evaluation-only information oracle using matched-serial current-block concrete conflict edges
measurement_policy.aria_fb: same-VM post-consensus speculative discovery plus Aria Rule-2-like fallback
measurement_policy.vegeta: same-VM pre-consensus concrete discovery adaptation followed by dependency replay
measurement_policy.bank_dependencies: included because performance executes the full native CosmWasm workload; storage-only filtering is used only for source-topology fidelity

threshold_policy: No performance outcome threshold is defined. This file freezes evaluation parameters before observing scheduler results.
